Escalation rules (proposed):

- Short memo summarizing any new risk items that alter SLAs or cost.

Next milestone: once Acme bundles redlines (target 2026-12-22) Redwood will send first-pass responses by 2026-12-24 (if <=5 items) or by 2026-12-27 (if extended).
